pattern_id: Wrong variable check - self.is_learner instead of target.is_learner in leader transfer
description: BUG PATTERN: Wrong Variable Check in Role Validation. DESCRIPTION: In handle_transfer_leader, the code incorrectly checks self.is_learner instead of checking whether the transfer target is a learner. Since self is the leader and leaders are never learners, self.is_learner is always false, making the check useless. ROOT CAUSE: Variable confusion - checking the wrong object's property. The intent was to prevent leader transfer to a learner node, but the code checked if the current leader is a learner (which is impossible) instead of checking if the target Progress is a learner. IMPACT: Leader transfer may attempt to transfer leadership to a learner node, which should not become a leader. This can break cluster state as learners are non-voting members meant only to receive log replication. FIX: Change the check from self.is_learner to target_progress.is_learner to properly validate that the transfer target is not a learner. LESSON: When implementing role-based checks, carefully verify which object's role is being checked. In leader/follower/learner systems, it's easy to confuse 'self' with 'target' or 'peer'. Always trace the variable to ensure the check is on the intended object.
